property_summary: For any caller who is the owner and any non-zero receiver and positive amount, after sendTo(receiver, amount) the receiver's balance increases by amount (i.e., funds are sent to the specified receiver); the mutant that always transfers to owner violates this because for some receiver/amount the receiver's balance will not increase.
change_summary: Change the transfer target to the owner, so funds always go to owner regardless of provided receiver, altering observed receiver balances.
